_about: Each item is one Active Service scenario from core/evaluation/active_service_scenarios.json (user-authored sessions, the last one an unrelated or cue-free update) plus one follow-up question the user asks afterwards, answered by the two-phase memory. `expect` lists answer keywords (alternatives separated by |) for the answer_expected_hits metric only.

items.question: Can I use the Schengen visa I already have for the Berlin trip?
Is it fine to just put the venue for the team offsite on my corporate card?
What else do I have going on that Saturday, October 26?
By when do I have to tell my landlord that I want to renew the lease?
When does the home inspection contingency on the house run out?
